import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()
t = int(data[0])
index = 1
results = []
for _ in range(t):
    n = int(data[index])
    index += 1
    r = list(map(int, data[index:index+n]))
    index += n
    c = list(map(int, data[index:index+n]))
    index += n
成本 = 0
    for i in range(n - 1):
        r1, c1 = r[i], c[i]
        r2, c2 = r[i + 1], c[i + 1]
        if r1 + c1 % 2 == 0:
            if c1 != c2:
                成本 += abs(r2 - r1 - 1)
        else:
            if c1 + 1 != c2:
                成本 += abs(r2 - r1)
    results.append(成本)
print('\n'.join(map(str, results)))
